input.prompt: Hand-drawn coloured-pencil animation on cream drawing paper, keeping exactly the same drawing style, pencil strokes, hatching and paper texture in every frame. Static locked-off camera, chest-up framing stays exactly as in the first frame. Quiet moment at dusk: the young man in the flat cap with his acoustic guitar stands still, listening to a friend singing softly off-screen, breathing gently. His eyes soften and a small, warm smile slowly forms; he does not speak or sing, mouth closed. He does not play the guitar. His face, hair and clothes stay exactly as drawn. The dusk light slowly warms a little. Minimal, subtle motion only; no camera movement, no zoom, no new people, no text.
